map.听音识别音程与和弦，提升你的音乐听力: Listen and identify intervals and chords to improve your musical ear
map.点击播放，听后选择答案: Click play, listen and then choose an answer
map.耳训练器是一款基于 Web Audio API 的在线听音训练工具，帮助你提升音: The Ear Trainer is an online listening training tool built on the Web Audio API that helps you improve your musical ear. By practicing interval and chord recognition repeatedly you can hear pitch relationships faster, laying a solid foundation for sight-singing and ear training, improvisation and composition.
map.同时发声 / 琶音两种播放方式: Two playback modes: together or arpeggiated
map.纯前端处理，无需联网: Pure front-end processing, no network needed
map.音乐学生日常练耳: Daily ear training for music students
map.乐理课程辅助训练: An aid for music theory classes
map.📚 深度解析：耳训练器（音程/和弦辨识）: 📚 Deep Dive: Ear Trainer (Interval and Chord Recognition)
map.听两个音判音程（小二度到大七度），练相对音感: Listen to two notes and judge the interval (from a minor second to a major seventh) to train relative pitch
map.听和弦判类型（大/小/属七等），提升和声辨识: Listen to a chord and judge its type (major, minor, dominant seventh and so on) to improve harmonic recognition
map.反复随机出题并即时反馈，建立音程与听感的映射: Repeated random questions with instant feedback build the mapping between intervals and what you hear
map.相邻音名半音差：小二度 1、大二度 2、小三度 3、大三度 4、纯四度 5、三全: The semitone difference between adjacent note names: minor second 1, major second 2, minor third 3, major third 4, perfect fourth 5, tritone 6, perfect fifth 7, minor sixth 8, major sixth 9, minor seventh 10, major seventh 11, octave 12.
map.同时响 C-E-G 为大三（明亮）、C-E♭-G 为小三（柔和）、C-E-G-B: C-E-G sounding together is major (bright), C-E♭-G is minor (soft) and C-E-G-B♭ is a dominant seventh (tense). Distinguish them by color and completeness.
map.怎么练相对音感？: How Do You Train Relative Pitch?
map.从纯五度、大三度等色彩鲜明的音程入手，记住参照曲（如《星球大战》开头纯五度），再: Start with intervals that have a distinctive color such as the perfect fifth and the major third, memorize a reference song (the perfect fifth at the opening of Star Wars, for example), then extend to every semitone level.
map.先分大/小三和弦（明/暗），再加属七（解决感）、大七（爵士柔光）；每次听后看答案: First separate major and minor chords (bright and dark), then add the dominant seventh (a sense of resolution) and the major seventh (the soft glow of jazz). After each listen, check the answer to build auditory memory.
